label: owns or is parent of
definition: Person or organization X owns business/organization/property Y or is its corporate parent.
scope_notes: Inverse of subsidiary/unit ownership family, allowing person owners and property. Officeholding, authorship and control without ownership alone are insufficient.

facts.reason: Walt Disney Company explicitly owns ABC and is its parent/owner.
Murdoch explicitly owns Fox and is its owner; chairman/control alone would be weaker.
Gross writes/says material in The Times; authorship/publication is not ownership.
Cablevision explicitly owns Madison Square Garden and is its owner.
Dolan explicitly owns Madison Square Garden in one row; other rows express chairman/control.
